articles.summary: McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE: MH; “McGraw Hill” and the “Company”), a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, today announced that it will participate in the following conferences: Morgan Stanley Business Services One-on-One Day : May 11, 2026 – The Company’s Investor Relations team will participate in investor meetings. 21st Annual Needham Technology, Media, Consumer Conference : May 14, 2026 – Philip Moyer, McGraw Hill’s President and CEO, will participate in a fireside chat. The presentation is scheduled for 12:45 pm ET. J.P. Morgan 2026 Global Technology, Media, and Communications Conference : May 18, 2026, Boston, MA – Philip Moyer, McGraw Hill’s President and CEO, will participate in a fireside chat and in investor meetings. articles.title: McGraw Hill Announces Participation in Upcoming Investor Conferences

articles.summary: McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE: MH; “McGraw Hill” and the “Company”), a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, will report fiscal fourth quarter and full-year financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026, on Thursday, June 11, 2026. The Company will host a conference call via webcast beginning at 8:30 a.m. ET and will issue a press release reporting its results prior to the call. To access the listen only webcast, to view a replay, or to access the earnings release materials, visit the event section of the company’s investor relations website at McGraw Hill, Inc. - Investor Relations . The conference call live QA can be accessed by registering online at the Event Registration Page , at which time registrants will receive dial-in information as well as a conference ID.
